title: antiaris toxicaria subsp. humbertii
intro: Antiaris toxicaria subsp. humbertii, commonly known as the Madagascar Manilkara, is a plant species within the Sapotaceae family, native to Madagascar. The health benefits of Antiaris toxicaria subsp. humbertii include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The plant is reported to exhibit therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antimalarial properties, which can help in reducing inflammation, preventing infections, and treating malaria. The bioactive constituents of Antiaris toxicaria subsp. humbertii include triterpenoids, flavonoids, and other compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
